$comment: What the Users module keeps local because no backend list stands behind it: the metric definitions, the two category group headings, and the username rules (the backend enforces only what the Business.slug column does: a slug shape, unique, 255 long). Every other value list the module shows is read from the server: users/vocabularies/, users/analytics/, audit/ (the event labels and their tones are derived from the audit rows themselves), v1/engine/seller-options/, admin taxonomy/ and vocab/user-deactivate-reasons/ (PanelVocab rows, 2026-09-16 -- the reason a person picks is still stored on CustomUser.deactivatedReason as free text and repeated on the audit line; only the list of suggestions moved). The per-state city suggestions are users/vocabularies/ stateCities, derived from the saved state/city pairs (2026-09-16).

categoryGroups.label: Industry
categoryGroups.note: What they sell or work in.

metricDefinitions.label: Total registered
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct platform_user rows retained as of the period end.
metricDefinitions.caution: Includes users with no term, members and past members. Excludes deactivated accounts from the ACTIVE base but never from history.

metricDefinitions.label: New registrations
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users whose registered_at falls in the period.
metricDefinitions.caution: Failed and partial registrations are excluded at intake, not here.

metricDefinitions.label: Profile completion
metricDefinitions.formula: Users meeting the configured completion threshold for profile v1.
metricDefinitions.caution: Re-graded when the profile schema versions. Old rows keep the version they were graded against.

metricDefinitions.label: Active users / MAU
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users with at least one qualifying platform event in the window.
metricDefinitions.caution: UNAVAILABLE until UM-OD-10 defines the qualifying-event taxonomy. Shown as unavailable, never as zero.

metricDefinitions.label: Deactivated accounts
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users whose user_status is deactivated as of the period end.
metricDefinitions.caution: An account status, not a commercial one. A deactivated account may still have a live subscription in Finance, and cancelling one is a separate, deliberate act.

$comment_metricDefinitions: Conversion to a paid plan, renewal rate, churn, expiring-soon and revenue per member were defined here while this module owned memberships. They are asked of the subscription that holds the money now and are defined in Finance; a second definition here would be the disagreement this operation exists to remove.
